rules.ways.title: WAYS TO WIN
rules.ways.text: 5×5 grid, {ways} ways. A win needs the same symbol on 3 or more adjacent reels, starting from the leftmost reel. Every matching symbol on those reels counts, WILD included.
rules.ways.calc: Win = symbol value × number of ways.
rules.pays.title: SYMBOL VALUES
rules.pays.note: Value per way for the current bet.
rules.special.title: WILD & SCATTER
rules.wild.text: Substitutes for all symbols except SCATTER and charges, and has its own values.
rules.scatter.text: At most one per reel. Never destroyed by a blast. Triggers the bonuses.
rules.blast.title: BLAST & CARVE
rules.blast.text1: Charges blast before wins are counted, each clearing a square zone:
rules.blast.text2: A charge caught in a blast zone goes off too. The whole chain is carved into ONE giant symbol filling the area, WILD included, that counts on every cell it covers.
rules.blast.text3: Winning cells crumble and new symbols drop in. The sequence goes on as long as there is a win or a charge.
rules.bonus.title: BONUSES
rules.corner.title: CORNERSTONE
rules.corner.text: In bonuses, every carved cell adds +1 to the multiplier on Buck's granite block. It applies to every bonus win and never goes down.
rules.features.title: ONE-SPIN FEATURES
feature.blast.name: TNT SPIN
feature.mega.name: MEGA BLAST SPIN
feature.blast.rule: One spin with at least two charges that chain.
feature.mega.rule: One spin with a 4×4 log charge that carves a premium symbol or a WILD.
rules.modes.title: BUY BONUS
rules.modes.note: BUY BONUS is not available while ANTE BET is on.

welcome.blast.title: BLAST & CARVE
welcome.blast.body: Every TNT charge that lands blows up and carves one giant symbol across its whole zone: 2×2, 3×3 or 4×4.
welcome.bonus.title: SUNDOWN SHIFT
welcome.bonus.body: 3 Scatters: 10 free spins. Every carved cell adds +1 to the Cornerstone multiplier, which never goes down.

welcome.super.body: 4 Scatters: 12 free spins, and every charge in a spin is wired into one single blast.
